entries.femaleVariant: Black Lantern is still carrying traffic. Now it carries our shadow with it.
entries.maleVariant: Black Lantern is still carrying traffic. Now it carries our shadow with it.

entries.femaleVariant: You gave Morrow a map made of people. Make sure he remembers what the symbols mean.
entries.maleVariant: You gave Morrow a map made of people. Make sure he remembers what the symbols mean.

entries.femaleVariant: You protected the couriers and destroyed the only clean path upward. Iris calls that mercy. I call it an expensive preference.
entries.maleVariant: You protected the couriers and destroyed the only clean path upward. Iris calls that mercy. I call it an expensive preference.

entries.femaleVariant: Mara remembers one apartment now. Her own. That will have to count as a victory.
entries.maleVariant: Mara remembers one apartment now. Her own. That will have to count as a victory.

entries.femaleVariant: The freight yard still treats Pair Seven as an internal failure. No public description, no bounty. Clean work.
entries.maleVariant: The freight yard still treats Pair Seven as an internal failure. No public description, no bounty. Clean work.

entries.femaleVariant: Freight security circulated your description. Black Lantern knows the route was attacked, even if it does not know what survived.
entries.maleVariant: Freight security circulated your description. Black Lantern knows the route was attacked, even if it does not know what survived.

entries.femaleVariant: Whatever lead we kept or lost, the couriers were never infrastructure.
entries.maleVariant: Whatever lead we kept or lost, the couriers were never infrastructure.

entries.femaleVariant: No. They were leverage. Our disagreement is whether destroying the leverage removes the hand holding it.
entries.maleVariant: No. They were leverage. Our disagreement is whether destroying the leverage removes the hand holding it.

entries.femaleVariant: Morita is still out there. This only changes how we find him.
entries.maleVariant: Morita is still out there. This only changes how we find him.

entries.femaleVariant: Correct. You changed the route, not the destination. We adapt.
entries.maleVariant: Correct. You changed the route, not the destination. We adapt.

entries.femaleVariant: Payment transferred. Keep the channel open. Black Lantern was a route, not the destination.
entries.maleVariant: Payment transferred. Keep the channel open. Black Lantern was a route, not the destination.

entries.femaleVariant: Should've told you what I knew. Next time I sell confidence, ask what I'm using as collateral.
entries.maleVariant: Should've told you what I knew. Next time I sell confidence, ask what I'm using as collateral.
